task_message:
Case F39: segment the fibrous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 241x241x216 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. 

**Summary of the segmentation:**

- **Target:** A very large, heterogeneous T2-hyperintense fibrous soft-tissue tumor occupying most of the limb cross-section (axial slices ~25–195, coronal ~49–162, sagittal ~40–148).
- **Approach:** Located the lesion on axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets, seeded it with a positive point in its center, then verified the result across all three planes at multiple levels.
- **Checks performed:** Inspected the mask at the proximal, mid and distal ends in all planes (including past-the-mask review panels) and zoomed views of the boundary at axial 45/175 and coronal 77. The automatic candidates (C1–C5, 436/237/177 mL etc.) were judged to be normal adjacent tissue — subcutis/fat rim, the contralateral limb, and a superficial vessel — and were rejected. A `fill_holes` edit removed internal holes.
- **Final mask:** 737.8 mL, single dominant component (99.9%), boundary following the tumor margin in all three planes, saved with high confidence.
